events.title: You are always holding something in Burger Smash. That used to be a problem...
events.summary: Before the demo goes live tomorrow, a thank you to everyone who playtested Burger Smash.You played builds that were slower than they should have been, and you told us exactly where they dragged. The biggest thing we changed because of you is how your hands work.In Burger Smash you are always holding something. A patty, a bun, tomatoes, a take away bag. events.title: The Kitchen Opens Thursday
events.summary: The Burger Smash playtest goes live this Thursday the 24th and runs until Sunday the 27th.Before you jump in, here is something worth knowing.Most players assume the hardest part is cooking the burgers. It is not.The hardest part is the decision you make before a single customer arrives, where does everything go? The grill. The prep station. The serving counter. Get it right and orders flow. events.title: What happens before the first order changes everything...
events.summary: When you start a level in Burger Smash, before a single customer walks through the door, you're staring at an empty kitchen. This is the placement phase.The placement menu is where you decide everything. Where does the grill go? How close is it to the counter? Where are your toppings stations sitting relative to where you'll be running back and forth? events.title: Burger Smash is officially announced... Day 1 recap
events.summary: Yesterday we announced Burger Smash and we are blown away by the early response. In the first 24 hours we hit 219 Steam impressions, 208 store visits and picked up our first 4 wishlists. Every single one means the world to us as a two person team on our first game.Watch the announce trailer here: Thank you for the support... this is just the beginning.Antony & Lumbi Alnutmob
